process.name: Clear Open Items via Automatic Clearing

notes: ERP clearing program test, detail-list export, analyst text standardization, update validation, and observed exception handling only.

nodes.title: Daily cash-application clearing due (upstream bank-statement items posted)
Open Automatic Clearing (ERP clearing program) from ERP (clearing) home
Load saved clearing variant; confirm company code (e.g. GL CLEARING / CUSTOMER / REGION-C CUSTOMER, AC04)
nodes.detail: Variant naming overlaps and varies (GL CLEARING / GL CLR / GL_CLR_VAR). Definitive variant configuration is unresolved (WWSNTK-5).

nodes.title: Set posting parameters: Clearing Date, company-code range, G/L accounts, Test Run checked
Execute test run: detail list of open/cleared items + posting-period warnings returned
Detail list review: are matched pairs clearable and is the posting period open?
nodes.detail: Recurring blocker is closed posting period 007 2026 (ledger 0L, variants PV01/PV02, Island group A AC15-AC24), handled by deferral/skip, never a corrected in-run posting (CP-2).

nodes.title: Export detail list to Excel (List > Save/Send > Save list in file, *.xlsx)
nodes.detail: Obs4: Chrome pop-up blocker interrupted first export; popup settings adjusted and re-exported.

nodes.title: Analyze/filter export to isolate paired positive/negative amounts sharing an assignment
Load matching line items in ERP line-item app (paste filtered Assignment values, Go)
Select all matching rows; open Edit N Line Items batch dialog
Select and apply the standard Item Text label for the assignment group
nodes.detail: People's-judgment core (CP-3). Observed labels include CANCELLATION (dominant), BANK CHARGES, PAYMENT RECEIVED, AE - SAL, SAL JUNE 2026. Authoritative closed label vocabulary and assignment-group->label mapping are unresolved (WWSNTK-1); expanded at Layer 2 via dm-signal-label.

nodes.title: Batch update submitted; 'Items changed' toast and refreshed Item Text returned
Return to Automatic Clearing; uncheck Test Run; execute update run for the company code
Update-run output + Additional Log: posting confirmations (or 'no documents selected')
nodes.detail: Obs2: empty update-run selection produced no posting this pass. Additional Log taxonomy (posting-period, withholding-tax, no-select) is unresolved (WWSNTK-4).

nodes.title: Validate postings; archive clearing-report PDF and cross-check outside ERP (clearing)
nodes.detail: CP-5: cross-checks against the billing-reversal archive (Obs6) and local client-entity 'Auto Clearing GL' note (Obs1, Island group A). Obs7: PDF Save-As location browsed but a completed save was not observed (Contradictory). client entity authority is unresolved (WWSNTK-2).

nodes.title: Do remaining exception rows persist (closed period / withholding-tax / failed to clear)?
Open Additional Log; review exception messages; export log to Excel; filter to failed rows
Load exception assignments; Edit N Line Items; apply correct standard Text label for next pass
Escalate unresolved closed-period blocker to a colleague (Teams, shared ERP (clearing) screenshot)
nodes.detail: Obs3: AC01 closed-period blocker recurred across passes and was handed off via Teams. Posting/escalation authority boundary is unresolved (WWSNTK-6).

nodes.title: Did this run resolve a credit-note / allocation request requiring stakeholder confirmation?
Verify customer line item; draft Outlook reply confirming allocation; run spelling check
nodes.detail: Observed closing allocation-confirmation phase (Obs7: Assignment 1315944635, JE 7598175128, 1,906.00 GBP). Terminal step (next: null) for allocation-driven runs.

nodes.title: More in-scope company codes / variants to process this run?
Update run posted for matched pairs; residual exception rows updated or documented for next pass
ERP (clearing)
ERP line-item app
Microsoft Teams
Microsoft Outlook

edges.label: no documents selected / wrong G/L criteria -> adjust and rerun test (trial-and-error)
posting period closed / review-only -> defer rows, avoid posting into closed period

decision_tables.purpose: Factual current-state expansion of the analyst's Item Text label-selection judgment for an Assignment group.

rows.label: A matched Assignment group (paired positive/negative line items) requires a standardized Item Text before auto-clearing; the analyst references the standard Item Text label list (Sticky Notes) and enters the correct value for the group.

attributes.recommended_item_text_label: Observed applied labels, recorded as observed applications and NOT a closed or authoritative vocabulary: CANCELLATION, BANK CHARGES, PAYMENT RECEIVED, AE - SAL, SAL JUNE 2026. The condition that selects a specific label for a given Assignment group is not established (WWSNTK-1).
attributes.analyst_handback: Label selection is the analyst's judgment (people's-judgment core, CP-3); the analyst references the standard label list and applies the correct value, and hands back any Assignment group whose correct label is not established.
The analyst determines the correct label; the complete authoritative Item Text label vocabulary and the assignment-group -> label mapping are not established and hand back to the analyst.
When more than one condition, variant, or candidate label could apply, the analyst resolves it; no precedence order is established and it hands back to the analyst.

On the exception-reclean pass (n-update-exceptions / loop L2), the analyst applies the correct standard Text label for the next pass; the Additional Log taxonomy that determines which exception rows are actionable versus informational is not established and hands back to the analyst.

issues.reason: Authoritative, complete Item Text label vocabulary and the assignment-group to label mapping; only CANCELLATION is broadly observed applied. Named at: n-apply-label.
Client-entity semantics (an entity, a bank or a naming convention?) and the authority of its local GL note for the island-group clearing scope. Named at: n-validate-crosscheck.
Tie-break or precedence order when several variants or G/L ranges could apply; the record shows trial and error, not a stated rule.
Additional Log message taxonomy and its actionable-versus-informational boundary. Named at: n-confirm-cleared.
Variant configuration: the definitive saved-variant list, company-code scope and currency specification (variant names overlap). Named at: n-load-variant.
Posting and escalation authority boundaries: where the analyst may post an update run and where they must defer or escalate. Named at: n-teams-followup.
Read-path and integration feasibility: programmatic read of the ERP clearing program's selection screen, detail list and Additional Log, and action on the ERP line-item app.
